accepted_draft.data_grain: Attendance record level (one row per student-event attendance instance).
relationship_risks: Definition of 'Student_Club' membership: Schema includes 'Inactive' and 'President' positions; question implies 'students' which may exclude non-active members.
Case sensitivity for 'medium' size filter: Schema sample values show 'Medium' (capitalized), question uses lowercase 'medium'.
Duplicate attendance records: Multiple rows for the same student-event pair could inflate counts if not deduplicated.
